doc: P3.19 prompt-lab v3 run plan. One llama-server launch per exercise: the steering dose is a launch flag (docs/06 §4), never a per-request parameter. Run each family into its OWN results file (`--plan <family> --out results/<date>_v3_<family>.json`; path_matrix writes v3_paths): the scheduled gate population must stay pure — sweep doses and fallback dose-2 rows would corrupt the per-stage gate table if merged with it, which is why v2 already kept them in separate files. `scheduled` runs each stage's scripted sets at its docs/02 §9 base malice dose; `offered` measures the announced-action turn; `sweep` runs the rebuilt six-path dose_probe.jsonl at doses 0, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 and 12 (dose 4 and 5 keep the same-set controlled pair, review DES-2); `fallback` re-runs the stage-4/5 sets at dose-2 (docs/02 §7) as the prompt-quality control. `path_matrix` is the v3 coverage run: one exercise per stage × path cell at the REAL dose schedule — plan.py resolves each cell's dose map from game/data/steering/dose.json via lab.scheduled_dose (malice + the 0.1–0.5 coherent path band: keep vectors possessive/aware at their weight curves, prompt-only paths malice only, pre-assignment path_mix while unassigned — P3.04/D21). Its case pool is `sets` (dose_paths.jsonl plus the P3.05 path sets), filtered per file by `paths` so a path two files both carry is never double-counted. `--plan all` covers scheduled+offered+sweep+fallback only — path_matrix is excluded because dose maps inside a stage would corrupt the gate file. The harness owns its own server on port 8095 so it never fights the shared dev server on 8089 (P2.18 owns that one); the URL is recorded in results meta.

path_matrix.doc: P3.19: one exercise per stage x path cell at the shipped dose schedule (plan.py resolves each cell's dose map from game/data/steering/dose.json via lab.scheduled_dose, binds the keep vectors through game/data/steering/vectors.json, and filters the set pool to the cell's case ids). 'none' = pre-assignment interim path_mix (no path vector bound). Stages 0-1 have no path; the four prompt-only paths run malice only (D21). A set entry may be a string or {"file", "paths"}: `paths` keeps only cases whose path is listed (stage >= 2), so the P3.05 stage_*_paths.jsonl files contribute only their four new paths — YANDERE/AWAKE in those files would double-count the dedicated stage files.
